name: cliw_e2e
description: Standalone checks for a deployed staging website

scripts.e2e:staging: node -e "require('./staging-url').requireStagingUrl()" && NODE_ENV=staging GLOSSARY_SAMPLE_SEED=${GLOSSARY_SAMPLE_SEED:-42} pnpm run e2e:wait && NODE_ENV=staging GLOSSARY_SAMPLE_SEED=${GLOSSARY_SAMPLE_SEED:-42} pnpm run e2e
scripts.e2e:production: NODE_ENV=production GLOSSARY_SAMPLE_SEED=${GLOSSARY_SAMPLE_SEED:-42} pnpm run e2e:wait && NODE_ENV=production GLOSSARY_SAMPLE_SEED=${GLOSSARY_SAMPLE_SEED:-42} pnpm run e2e
